verdict.rationale: smolagents natively supports multi-agent orchestration via managed_agents, letting a manager CodeAgent delegate to subagents (e.g., web_agent) with documented example of multiple agents collaborating; docs also show sharing/loading agents to/from Hub for reuse. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of complex handoff patterns or crew-style orchestration beyond the single documented manager/subagent example.
